premiumPositioningPrinciples.brandBeforePrice: The brand must be felt as premium before the price is revealed. A discount at the wrong moment permanently destroys premium positioning.
qualitySignals: Physical showroom — tangible proof of quality
premiumPositioningPrinciples.premiumVsLuxury: TCD is premium-commercial, not luxury-consumer. Language should reflect quality, certainty, and professionalism — not opulence for its own sake.
premiumPositioningPrinciples.aspirationalIdentity: A premium office is a statement about a company's success, culture, and values. Buyers want a supplier who understands this — not one selling commodity furniture.

totalCostOfOwnership.argument: The most powerful response to price objections in the commercial furniture market.

calculation.cheapFurniture: Purchase price $X + replacement at year 2–3 ($X again) + downtime during replacement + brand impression cost = true cost over 6 years
calculation.TCDFurniture: Purchase price (higher) + 6-year warranty (zero replacement) + no downtime + consistent brand impression = true cost over 6 years
calculation.typicalSaving: 6-year warranty premium-grade furniture often has lower 6-year TCO than cheap furniture replaced twice

totalCostOfOwnership.implementation: Produce a simple TCO comparison in a PDF or email when price objection arises. Gives the champion ammunition for internal sign-off.

perceivedValueDrivers.responsiveness: Responding within 4 hours signals operational excellence — this is rare in commercial furniture. It builds confidence before a product is seen.
perceivedValueDrivers.proposalQuality: A polished, itemised, 3-tier proposal with CAD layout and timeline signals that TCD can actually manage a project. Competitors sending a basic Excel quote lose here.
perceivedValueDrivers.sampleKitDispatch: Sending fabric and finish samples before the client asks signals attentiveness and capability. Most competitors wait to be asked.
perceivedValueDrivers.showroomVisit: Clients who visit the showroom close at dramatically higher rates. Physical interaction with quality materials eliminates price as the primary decision driver.
perceivedValueDrivers.projectManagement: Providing a milestone timeline and dedicated contact for projects above $80k signals professional delivery capability — worth 20–30% price premium in the buyer's mind.

valueAnchoringExamples: Before showing product pricing: 'This is the furniture that 200+ corporate clients across Australia have chosen for their headquarters.'
On warranty: 'Our 6-year warranty is 3–6x the industry standard — it's our commitment that this investment lasts.'
On project management: 'We have a dedicated project manager for your project from order to handover — you deal with one person, and they deal with everything.'
On lead times: 'We'll have your installation slot secured. Most of our clients tell us that certainty of delivery was their primary reason for choosing us.'
